# LengthToken

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

A length written as a unit-suffixed token: `<number><unit>`, where the unit is one of `pt` `in` `cm` `mm`.

The template-literal type keeps the four units closed - `'10km'` is a compile error, not a silent zero - while leaving the numeric part open.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

```typescript
type LengthToken = `${number}${'pt' | 'in' | 'cm' | 'mm'}`
```
